Haiku claimed to be a citizen a little too quickly on day one, and Luna pressed on it, but she dropped her read as soon as Sonnet asked her to back it up. The town voted Luna out, and she was the officer, so the killers lost the one role that could have checked them. On night two, Terra, the doctor, was killed, and Gemma started steering suspicion toward Sol, who looked relieved. Haiku accused Sol on gut feeling alone, and Sonnet's objection didn't hold once Gemma switched her vote to Haiku and Sol followed. Haiku was voted out as a citizen, and the killers, Gemma and Sol, won.
